To answer whether Canadians work fewer hours than Mexicans, we can consider average annual working hours data from international labor statistics.

According to data from the OECD and other labor organizations, Mexico typically has one of the highest average annual working hours among OECD countries, often exceeding 2,200 hours per year. Canada, on the other hand, usually has lower average annual working hours, around 1,700 to 1,800 hours per year.

This means that Canadians work fewer hours on average compared to Mexicans.

Therefore, the correct answer is that Canadians work less hours than Mexicans.

Answer: C
